applicationEvidence.reason: The real BJ postal API fails closed because no BJ production Postal Context descriptor exists. The deterministic fallback showed the real app, two map canvases and, after explicit candidate selection, a live non-postal Cotonou result with BJ AGID identity and civic context. No postcode request, postal geometry or translucent postal overlay was available. This is Address Context evidence only, not M2 postal evidence.

limitations: Current no-postcode evidence excludes BJ from postcode-data creation; it does not authorize a country-wide or administrative placeholder surface.
Delivery-office identifiers, postal-box numbers and home-delivery services are delivery objects, not postcodes or postal geometry.
Reviewed rights do not establish a compatible open postal dataset licence.
The real BJ API returned unsupported and no BJ postal area was rendered.
The merged live place-search result ordering placed unrelated Photon results before Cotonou; explicit candidate selection was required and the issue remains outside Postal Context promotion.
In-app Browser and local image viewing failed at the Windows helper boundary; deterministic checks are not reported as manual inspection.
